name: mirage
text:
Honest answer: not yet, on the evidence I have. The latest digest (11-16) has the engine's 2,622 settled orders at -1.7% ROI (-$34.74 on $2,137 staked). That is too small to prove the engine loses; it is not evidence it makes money.
Where it did well: NBA +6.8% (620 bets), NFL +7.0% (78), player props about +25% on 137 bets in the older study, team totals +19%. Where it lost: NCAAB -5.1% on 1,570 bets, the biggest drag, and game totals -8.1%. I've already removed totals and spreads from auto-bet.
I haven't checked whether NCAAB beats the closing line, so I don't yet know if that loss is bad luck or a real leak. That is my next step. The engine has also been idle: your wallet cash is about $0.01 and the phone switched it off on 11-16.
So I wouldn't pay for more than one feed: PropLine Streaming Lite ($39) is the one I'd keep, and only if the engine is actually going to trade. The free sockets stay. Before any bigger spend, I'll check NCAAB's closing-line value, then restrict the engine to NBA, NFL and props if NCAAB is a leak. If a feed is only feeding NCAAB, it isn't worth paying for.
